#OhGeesy’s Son Sincere Is Making His Dad Proud After Scoring A Perfect 100% On His Latest Test! Beyond The Fame & Music, It’s Moments Like These That Show A Different Side Of OhGeesy As A Loving & Supportive Father 🥹💙📚✏️

OhGeesy, whose real name is Alejandro Carranza, is a Mexican-American rapper, songwriter, entrepreneur, and father from Los Angeles, California. Born on November 27, 1993, OhGeesy rose to fame as a founding member of the legendary West Coast rap group Shoreline Mafia alongside Fenix Flexin, Rob Vicious, and Master Kato. The group became one of the biggest movements in the Los Angeles rap scene with popular records like “Musty,” “Bands,” “Nun Major,” and “Bottle Service.” Following the group’s hiatus, OhGeesy launched a successful solo career, releasing projects including Geezyworld, Geezyworld 2, and Paid N Full. His hit records, including “GEEKALEEK,” helped establish him as one of the most recognizable artists in modern West Coast hip-hop. He later reunited with Fenix Flexin to bring Shoreline Mafia back, continuing to perform at major concerts, festivals, and nightclubs across the country. 

Beyond his success in music, OhGeesy is also a proud father to his son, Sincere, who was born in 2019. Throughout his career, OhGeesy has spoken about balancing fatherhood with the demands of being a successful recording artist. While millions of fans know him for his music, his role as a father remains an important part of his life. From representing Los Angeles on major stages to celebrating his son’s accomplishments in school, OhGeesy continues to show that his life is about more than just fame and music. 🏆
